The closest match is [1], which directly studies computational political bias in Wales by analyzing bias in Nation.Cymru’s political reporting with an NLP pipeline. [1] It finds measurable differential framing across Welsh party mentions, including more negative treatment of Reform UK and more favourable framing for Plaid Cymru. [1]

A broader but less Wales-specific fit is [4], which compares human and LLM-based political bias detection in news media and finds RoBERTa aligns best with human labels among transformer baselines. [4] Papers [2], [3], [5], [6], [8], [9], and [10] focus on political bias or partisanship in LLMs, media, or summarization, but not specifically on Wales. [2, 3, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10]
